novel_features.name: Local-corpus FTS search
novel_features.description: Full-text search across every caption, hashtag, mention, location, owner handle, and IG-generated alt-text in your local archive — no API call.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 over the local SQLite catalog makes the entire archive searchable as a corpus; instaloader stores captions in sidecar .txt files that you can only grep one profile at a time.
novel_features.example: instagram-pp-cli search "sunset golden hour" --owner natgeo --kind post --json --select results.shortcode,results.owner,results.taken_at,results.caption_snippet
novel_features.why_it_matters: When the archive is the corpus, agents can answer cross-profile questions ("every post that mentions person X across these 40 accounts") without re-fetching from Instagram.

novel_features.name: Alt-text capture and search
novel_features.description: Captures Instagram's auto-generated accessibility_caption ("may contain: two people, sunglasses, outdoors") into the local catalog and exposes it via --alt search.
novel_features.rationale: The accessibility_caption field is in every media_info response but no surveyed extractor (instaloader, gallery-dl, ig-dl) ships it; this turns the archive into a coarse visual-search index for free.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent pick representative images by visual content from the local archive without OCR, vision models, or extra API calls.

novel_features.name: Watchlist with shared rate budget
novel_features.description: Register profiles and hashtags as a watchlist, then run one sync that walks the whole list under one shared rate budget instead of looping a shell over instaloader runs.
novel_features.rationale: instaloader and gallery-dl have no first-class watchlist; you have to script it, and each script invocation re-handshakes auth and re-spends the rate budget from zero.
novel_features.example: instagram-pp-cli watch add natgeo nasa rei && instagram-pp-cli sync watchlist --json --select summary.profile,summary.added,summary.skipped
novel_features.why_it_matters: One predictable command handles the recurring weekly sync, so an agent can be tasked with "sync the watchlist" without managing per-target state.

novel_features.name: Highlight-tray diff
novel_features.description: Compares the current highlight tray and items for a profile against the prior snapshot in the local store, reporting added, removed, and renamed items.
novel_features.rationale: Highlights silently change when creators delete clips or rename trays; gallery-dl and instaloader treat every pull as fresh and lose the previous version.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Brand and rights teams need the previous version of a highlight when something gets pulled — only a local snapshot can answer this.

novel_features.name: What's new since last sync
novel_features.description: Lists every shortcode added to the local catalog since the prior sync run, grouped by owner, with caption snippets.
novel_features.rationale: instaloader's --fast-update stops silently when it hits a known shortcode; it never tells you what was new. The local downloaded_at timestamps make this a trivial SQL query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Gives agents and researchers a delta after every sync without re-walking IG.

novel_features.name: Dry-run with size and rate-budget estimate
novel_features.description: Walks the cursor without downloading, sums estimated bytes from each media_info, and reports request count plus wall-clock under the configured --rate.
novel_features.rationale: Instagram's pagination can stall at 12 posts (instaloader#2307) — you want to know up front how many requests and bytes a sync will cost.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can preview cost before committing the rate budget; humans can decide whether to run now or split across days.

novel_features.name: Mirror-diff (remote vs local)
novel_features.description: Cursor-walks shortcodes from Instagram, set-diffs against the local download_history, and reports both new posts and posts that were deleted upstream since the last sync.
novel_features.rationale: Posts get deleted; rights and DMCA teams need to preserve evidence. The local archive plus a fresh upstream walk is the only place that diff exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Deleted-evidence preservation is the only way to answer "which posts disappeared since last week" — Instagram itself doesn't tell you.

novel_features.name: Carousel slide-kind filter
novel_features.description: Filter carousel children by media kind so a sync keeps only stills (skipping reels and video children) or only videos.
novel_features.rationale: instaloader's --slide 1-3 filters by index, not by kind; designers building moodboards want "only the still images" without slide-by-slide knowledge.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets agents scope a download to a media type without inspecting each carousel manually.

novel_features.name: Sync-health doctor
novel_features.description: Joins sessions, rate_limit_events, and download_history to report last-sync per watchlist entry, current 429 backoff state, session validity, and cursor-stall warnings.
novel_features.rationale: instagrapi's docs explicitly say the library does not back off for you and a stalled cursor is a known failure mode (instaloader#2307); a doctor that reads local rate-limit telemetry is the only honest health check.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can decide whether to attempt a sync now or wait, and humans can spot a session that is one bad request from a checkpoint.

novel_features.name: LLM-rerank theme search
novel_features.description: Opt-in --rerank flag pipes the top FTS candidates' captions, alt-text, and first comments to whichever LLM env is set (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or OLLAMA_HOST) and returns the LLM's relevance ranking.
novel_features.rationale: FTS finds the right vocabulary; LLMs find the right theme. Re-ranking the small candidate set keeps cost bounded and keeps the CLI offline by default.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent or designer search by theme even when captions and alt-text don't use the same words; no model is bundled and no LLM call happens unless --rerank is passed.

narrative.headline: Single-binary Instagram archiver with a local SQLite catalog, full-text search across captions and Instagram-generated alt-text, and an MCP server in the same binary.
narrative.value_prop: instagram-pp-cli is a pure-Go alternative to instaloader and gallery-dl for archiving public and authenticated Instagram pages. Every download lands in a local SQLite catalog, so search, watchlists, highlight-tray diff, and remote-vs-local mirror-diff are SQL queries — not shell loops over .txt sidecars. One static binary, no Python, no ffmpeg, no subprocesses.
narrative.auth_narrative: Instagram's reachable surface is the reverse-engineered web/private API, gated by session cookies. Authenticate by importing cookies from your logged-in Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Arc/Brave/Edge profile (`auth login --chrome`) or by pasting a sessionid value (`auth login --sessionid <value>`). Username+password login is not shipped — it is the most reliable way to trip a checkpoint or get an account banned. After login, the device fingerprint and cookies persist in the local store so the next run reuses them. Run `doctor` to confirm the session is still good before a long sync.

quickstart.comment: Import the sessionid + csrftoken + ds_user_id cookies from your logged-in Chrome profile
Confirm the session is healthy before spending the rate budget
Smoke-test the auth and HTTP layer on one known-good post
Estimate request count, bytes, and wall-clock before committing to a profile sync

quickstart.command: instagram-pp-cli watch add natgeo nasa rei
quickstart.comment: Register a watchlist of profiles for incremental sync
Walk the whole watchlist under one shared rate budget; only fetches new shortcodes

troubleshoots.symptom: 401 Unauthorized 'Please wait a few minutes' on every request
troubleshoots.fix: Run `instagram-pp-cli doctor`; if backoff.until is in the past, your session was invalidated — re-import cookies with `auth login --chrome`. If backoff is active, wait it out — re-logging in from a new IP escalates the ban risk.
Stop and resolve the challenge in your normal browser session, then re-run `auth login --chrome` to import the refreshed cookies. Do NOT retry login from the CLI — it makes the checkpoint sticky.

troubleshoots.symptom: Cursor stalls at ~12 posts when paginating a profile
troubleshoots.fix: Run with `--rate 20` (or lower) to slow the pagination, and confirm cookies are imported (`doctor`); anonymous access is throttled aggressively in 2025+.

troubleshoots.symptom: `get` fetches succeed but `user` returns no posts
troubleshoots.fix: Profile is private and your session does not follow it, OR the cursor cache is stale. Run `instagram-pp-cli user <handle> --no-resume` to walk from scratch.

troubleshoots.symptom: Watchlist sync skips a profile every run
troubleshoots.fix: Inspect `instagram-pp-cli doctor --full --json`; a `cursor_stalled` flag means the last cursor token is rejected — clear it with `--no-resume`.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need to archive public or authenticated Instagram pages and search across the result. It excels at recurring sync jobs over a watchlist of profiles and hashtags, alt-text-aware visual search across the local archive, highlight-tray diffs, and dry-run cost estimation before committing the rate budget. It is not the right tool for posting, following, or interacting — it only reads.

recipes.title: Search the entire archive for a person across every synced profile
recipes.explanation: FTS5 query joined back to the posts table; the dotted --select narrows the response so an agent can rank without parsing kilobytes of unused fields.

recipes.title: Build a moodboard of stills from a watchlist
recipes.explanation: After `instagram-pp-cli sync watchlist` populates the local catalog, alt-text search returns only carousel stills matching the visual brief.

recipes.title: Diff a profile's highlights week-over-week
recipes.command: instagram-pp-cli highlights download natgeo && instagram-pp-cli highlights diff natgeo --json --select changes.tray,changes.kind,changes.shortcode
recipes.explanation: Sync writes a fresh snapshot; diff compares against the prior one and reports what changed.

recipes.title: Estimate before downloading a profile
recipes.explanation: Walks the cursor without saving; lets an agent decide whether to run now or split across days.

recipes.title: Find every post deleted upstream since last sync
recipes.explanation: Set-diffs the live cursor against the local download_history; preserves evidence even when the upstream post is gone.
